en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a bustling city square with a prominent equestrian statue at its center. Surrounding the square are European-style buildings, visible trees, and people walking or working. An old tram and various people in traditional attire are present, contributing to the historical atmosphere. The top of the postcard includes the printed text: '3. - ALEXANDRIA. - Mohamed Aly Square.'
